class.name: ConservatoryDebugBridge
class.brief_description: An internal class used by [i]The Conservatory[/i] to interface the .NET Debugger with the engine's C++ code.
class.description: An internal class used by [i]The Conservatory[/i] to interface the .NET Debugger with the engine's C++ code. This is not available for use in mods and its methods require knowledge of how the internal data is structured as it involves blitting types.

method.name: are_engine_memory_metrics_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the engine was compiled in a way that allows it to track the memory usage of all resources and nodes.

method.name: intercept_godot_logging_using_ptr
method.description: Delegate signature: [code]void (*)(const uint64_t p_userdata, const uint8_t *p_message, const int32_t p_message_length, const uint8_t *p_error, const int32_t p_error_length, const uint8_t *p_function_name, const int32_t p_function_name_length, const uint8_t *p_file_name, const int32_t p_file_name_length, const int32_t p_line, const uint8_t p_severity_rating, const uint8_t p_is_bbcode)[/code]

method.name: is_engine_error_breaking_possible
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the engine was compiled in a way that allows breaking when one of Godot's [code]ERROR[/code] macros is triggered.

method.name: set_ptrs
method.description: The first pointer is a [code]bool[/code] pointer which determines if the engine should trigger a breakpoint when one of Godot's [code]ERROR[/code] macros is triggered. The second pointer is a parameterless [code]bool[/code]-returning function pointer which returns whether or not a debugger is attached. It is used with the [param should_break_on_error] parameter, as it will skip breaking if there is no debugger to handle said breakpoint.

method.name: should_break_on_engine_error
method.description: Calls the method set by [method set_ptrs]; see its documentation for more information.
